paragraphs: QQQ is +1.40% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is +3/100 (Mixed / Neutral). Score path: pre-market -38 → now +3; open +17 → now +3 (deteriorated 14 points).

The main live drivers are Mega-caps are supportive: Live · 7-stock basket +1.82% | 5/7 positive | QQQ +1.40% | relative +0.42 pp. It changed from mixed to positive after the baseline snapshot. Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 5.142%, +1.1 bp since the opening snapshot. The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.763% (+2.7 bp vs prev close).
The upside move is broadly confirmed by Nasdaq internals (semiconductors positive, mega-caps positive, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher, semiconductor leadership rolling over, a material volatility expansion.
